title: 道路排水グレーチング
description: 実際に開いたスリット、脱着式の鋳鉄格子、支持リブと固定ボルトを備えた道路排水口。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A cast-iron street grate with genuine open slots, removable grate bars, supporting ribs and frame anchors. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
